lines.text: You've finished this jar. What's one useful thing you could do with it? Sustain-a-Pet turns that everyday decision into a small action that helps your virtual companion grow.
lines.spoken: You've finished this jar. What's one useful thing you could do with it? Sustain a Pet turns that everyday decision into a small action, that helps your virtual companion grow.

lines.text: Sustainable habits can feel disconnected from their results. We built a garden where small actions earn care, growth and restoration.
GreenLens looks at a photo or short description and suggests one manageable eco quest. First, it says exactly where your note goes.
I'll describe this jar in a few words. Here's what it suggests.
It spotted a rinsed pasta sauce jar, and suggests keeping it for dry food like rice or pasta, instead of buying a new container. Less single-use packaging.
I've done the action, so I can confirm it and earn a reward. Completion is self-reported. The photo doesn't prove the action happened.
Now something vaguer: a few things from a kitchen drawer. GreenLens asks one follow-up question.
Dead batteries get a different quest, with a curated link for Ontario.
The model proposes the action. Our server validates the response, chooses rewards from fixed rules, and supplies curated recycling links where we have coverage.
When the AI provider fails, GreenLens labels its prerecorded tip clearly. The rest of the garden still works, so an unavailable model doesn't end the experience.
This is the deployed app at sustain-a-pet.deployxa.online. Players can start without an account, use it on their phone, and keep progress in this browser.
lines.spoken: This is the deployed app, at sustain a pet dot deploy x a dot online. Players can start without an account, use it on their phone, and keep progress in this browser.

lines.text: Sustain-a-Pet connects something near you, one practical action, and a companion worth coming back for.
